What they wrote
I'm an orthopedic surgeon. I've been a QME since 2019 and I'm licensed in California. I'm looking at groups that handle scheduling and report logistics so I can focus on the evaluations. Email is the best way to reach me.

Suggested reading, from their own words
Specialty: orthopedic surgeon ("I'm an orthopedic surgeon")
Licensed in: CA ("I'm licensed in California")
Certification: says they are a certified QME ("I've been a QME since 2019")
Looking for: established QME looking at the group ("I'm looking at groups that handle scheduling and report logistics so I can focus on the evaluations")
Available for a first call: not stated (a call window, not evaluation capacity)

Dear Dr. Okoye,

Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like you are already an established QME and are looking for support with scheduling and report logistics. We would be glad to set up a first conversation to learn more about what you are looking for and share how our team works.

Email is noted as your preferred way to be reached. If there is anything specific you would like us to cover on the call, please let us know.

Best regards,
[Your name], Expedient recruiting
